name: Silverstone Circuit
summary: Layout (Arena Grand Prix circuit, 5.891 km), direction and the flat height profile (EA lidar range 11.3 m vs game 11.6 m, RMS 0.7 m) are right. But the start / finish line and the pit lane are at the OLD pits on the National Pit Straight (Woodcote -> Copse), which F1 used until 2010; since 2011 the pits and the start / finish line are at the Silverstone Wing on the Hamilton Straight (Club -> Abbey), 2.85-3.04 km further round the lap. So 16 of the 17 seasons start in the wrong place. The derived banking adds 3.5-5.7 deg in slow corners that are within 1.8 deg in reality; two real overhead structures (the Wellington Straight bridges, the Wing footbridge) are missing.

findings.game: Line (dataset first vertex) at 52.07879, -1.01535 on the National Pit Straight between Woodcote and Copse; grid, gantry and pit lane there.
findings.real: en.wikipedia "2011 British Grand Prix": "the pits and the start/finish line moved to the straight between Club Corner and the new Abbey" (the Silverstone Wing). OSM: node 13036050131 raceway=finish [52.0682609, -1.0234867] lies 3.04 km after the game line (2851 m before it) on the Hamilton Straight; node 13036050130 raceway=start [52.0693366, -1.0221521] 150 m further on (start and finish lines differ at Silverstone: en.wikipedia "the RAC moved the start line forward at Silverstone but not, significantly, the finish line"). The game line is right only for the 2010 season (Arena layout with the old pits).
findings.proposedFix: START_AT 'gb-1948': [52.0682609, -1.0234867] (OSM node 13036050131, the finish / timing line) - or [52.0693366, -1.0221521] (the start node) if the grid position matters more than the timing line; plus pitSide -1 (the Wing pit lane is on the right). Season 2010 would then also start at the Wing (one line per circuit).
sources: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via the Overpass API, cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/overpass/gb-1948.json; relation 51160 "Silverstone Grand Prix", nodes 13036050130 / 13036050131

findings.game: Pit lane on the right of the National Pit Straight (lane 219 m before to 178 m after the line, entry 133 m before, exit 92 m after), next to the old pit building (scenery-data.js 'pit' building at 52.077865, -1.015755). The game's pit lane (js/track.js) is generated beside the start / finish straight from up to 250 m before to 250 m after the line; it cannot follow a real lane that leaves at a chicane or rejoins after the first corner.
findings.real: Since 2011 the F1 pit lane is the Wing lane, OSM way 227902927 ("International pit lane", 1130 m, relation 51160 role pit_lane): on the right of the Hamilton Straight, leaving the track 607 m before the finish node (at Vale, before Club) and rejoining 706 m after it (after Abbey / Farm). The old National pit lane (OSM way 227838385, 1009 m, right side, -509..+542 m about the game line) is the 2010 one. No source found for a limit other than 80 km/h.
findings.proposedFix: Follows from START_AT (the generated lane moves with the line); pitSide -1. tools/build-scenery.mjs should tag the Wing building (not looked up here) as kind pit so the garages are drawn there.
sources: OpenStreetMap (ODbL) via the Overpass API, cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/overpass/gb-1948.json; ways 227902927, 227838385

findings.game: Curvature-derived bank 3.4-5.7 deg in Abbey (3.5), Village (4.8-5.6), The Loop (-4.9..-5.7), Aintree (-4.0..-4.6), Brooklands (-3.9..-4.8), Luffield (4.2-4.8), Chapel (3.5-4.1), Stowe (3.4-3.6), Vale (-5.1..-5.7), Club (3.9-5.5).
findings.real: EA lidar cross slope: all those corners within 1.8 deg (Abbey 1.0-1.3, Village 1.6, Loop -1.7..-1.8, Aintree -0.8, Brooklands -0.3, Luffield 1.7-1.8, Chapel 0.6-0.8, Stowe 0.6, Vale +0.8 (the other side), Club -0.7..0.7). Silverstone is a flat former airfield; no banked corner published.
findings.proposedFix: bankOverrides from the lidar (proposedCorrection.bankOverridesFromLidar) or cap the derived bank on this circuit.
sources: Environment Agency LIDAR Composite DTM 1 m (Open Government Licence), WCS https://environment.data.gov.uk/spatialdata/lidar-composite-digital-terrain-model-dtm-1m (GetCoverage GeoTIFF, EPSG:27700); cached in devtests/track-audit/cache/ea-lidar/

findings.game: One deck over the road, on the Hangar Straight (lap s 1670, underside 8.1 m above the road) - correct.
findings.real: OSM: three structures cross over the lap: the Hangar Straight service bridge (way 4851856 + outline 605922107: present in the game); the Wellington Straight bridges (service way 126446852, footbridges 360074746 / 360077715 at ~52.0752, -1.0154: MISSING - no man_made=bridge outline there, so the scenery build never sees them); the Wing's enclosed glass footbridge over the Hamilton Straight ~150 m after the finish line (way 1412628537 building=bridge, min_height 14.5 m, height 18.5 m, with the indoor footway 1412628538: MISSING). Two tunnels pass under the lap at Copse (126446849, 507989195).
findings.proposedFix: tools/build-scenery.mjs: also emit decks for highway ways with bridge=yes and layer>0 that cross the lap, and building=bridge with min_height (the Wing footbridge, 14.5-18.5 m).

findings.game: GLO-90 heights: range 11.6 m; the drop through Vale -1.4 % (50 m) / -1.1 % (100 m), Vale falls 3.4 m; max +2.4 % / -1.5 % over 50 m; up to 2.2 m off on the Hamilton Straight; RMS 0.68 m.
findings.real: EA lidar: 144.9 m ASL (Hamilton Straight, by the finish line) to 156.2 m (112 m from Maggotts), range 11.3 m; the dip into Vale -3.8 % (50 m) / -3.3 % (100 m), Vale falls 5.1 m; max +1.9 % (Stowe) over 50 m. Only this one stretch differs by more than 2 pp.

measurements.method: devtests/track-audit/be-nl-de-gb/audit.mjs: game = tracks-data.js + js/track.js built in node (out/game-<id>.json from dump-game.js); OSM = Overpass (cache/overpass/<id>.json), the F1 lap chained from its raceway ways in their oneway direction; DEM sampled every 5 m along the OSM centreline, 25 m median + 5 m Gauss; game heights mapped to the OSM centreline by nearest point and aligned by the mean difference
